TanStack Router createRouter.description:
Create the router from the generated route tree. Requires createRouter from @tanstack/react-router and routeTree from ./routeTree.gen.

用生成的路由树创建 router；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createRouter，以及 ./routeTree.gen 导出的 routeTree。

TanStack Router type registration.description:
Register the router instance so every route path, param and search field is inferred globally. Place it in the module that creates the router.

注册 router 实例，使全局的路由路径、参数与 search 字段获得类型推导；写在创建 router 的模块里。

TanStack Router RouterProvider.description:
Render the router at the top of the application. Requires RouterProvider from @tanstack/react-router.

在应用顶层渲染 router；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 RouterProvider。

TanStack Router devtools.description:
Mount the router devtools inside the root route component, next to its Outlet. Requires TanStackRouterDevtools from @tanstack/react-router-devtools.

在根路由组件内、Outlet 旁挂载路由开发者工具；需要 @tanstack/react-router-devtools 的 TanStackRouterDevtools。

TanStack Router Vite plugin.description:
Register the route generator in a Vite config. It must come before the React plugin. Requires tanstackRouter from @tanstack/router-plugin/vite.

在 Vite 配置中注册路由生成器，必须排在 React 插件之前；需要 @tanstack/router-plugin/vite 的 tanstackRouter。
